meaning: An approval, confirmation or published version is missing or expired for this exact version.
fix: Publish, press Request approval, decide it (with an expiry), then activate or run again.

meaning: A source needs an API key or an approved destination that is not configured.
fix: Add the key in Setup -> API keys, or approve the webhook name in Automations -> Settings.

meaning: The workflow definition is not valid (bad reference, cycle, missing scope check, unknown setting, over a limit).
fix: Open the Checks panel: each problem names the step and the rule. Fix them, then publish.

meaning: Offline mode is on, so network steps pause.
fix: Turn offline mode off, then retry the paused run.

meaning: The run finished but some sources failed or were optional and unavailable.
fix: Open the run's warnings; results are marked partial and are not used as a baseline.

meaning: The draft changed since you loaded it (someone or something saved a newer revision).
fix: Reload the workflow and re-apply your edit.

meaning: The run was stopped.
fix: Start it again if you still want the result.

meaning: The target was refused by scope policy (private, local, unauthorised or malformed). It is never retried.
fix: Use a public target you are allowed to examine, or add a scope authorization for active collection; widening scope is your decision.

meaning: The scope authorization behind this run expired or was revoked.
fix: Renew the authorization, then request and grant the approval again.

meaning: A source is not installed, is offline, or failed.
fix: Install or repair it in Setup, retry later, or use the diagnosis's suggested alternative.

meaning: A step names a source that is not registered in this installation.
fix: Pick a registered source (the editor lists them) or install the tool in Setup.

meaning: The action needs the admin role.
fix: Sign in as the admin user (the local desktop session is the admin). Settings pages that change configuration are admin-only.

meaning: AI features are switched off.
fix: Settings -> AI: turn AI on and pick a profile. Every other feature works without AI; the Copilot still answers from built-in documentation.

meaning: The configured model could not be reached.
fix: For a local model check that Ollama (or your llama.cpp server) is running and the model name exists (Tool Manager / Setup show it). For a cloud profile check the key and the network. The Copilot falls back to documentation-only answers meanwhile.

meaning: These entities are already merged.
fix: Split the existing merge first if you want to change it.

meaning: Archived cases are read-only.
fix: Unarchive the case first if you need to add to it.

meaning: A real hardware receiver needs an ownership/authorisation assessment and your region.
fix: Complete the assessment on the Hardware tab, or use the simulated/replay device.

meaning: Subject-confirmed needs a recorded subject attestation.
fix: Tick 'subject attests' and say who attested and how in the basis.

meaning: A backup could not be created; the message gives the reason (for example a passphrase shorter than 8 characters).
fix: Use a passphrase of 8 or more characters and try again from Settings -> Encryption & backup.

meaning: The update manifest is malformed or its signature does not match the key built into the app.
fix: Re-publish the manifest with the right key (scripts/update_tool.py publish). The key cannot be changed from the UI.

meaning: Every decision needs a reason or method.
fix: Write why you made this decision; it is stored with your name and the time.

meaning: More sources were selected than one approval allows.
fix: Approve fewer sources at a time; each approval is capped to keep research bounded.

meaning: This kind of correction cannot be applied automatically.
fix: Choose 'accepted', then make the change yourself.

meaning: Searches can only be run on an open case.
fix: Reopen the case, or create a new one.

meaning: That candidate was reviewed again after the decision you tried to undo.
fix: Undo the later decision first, then the earlier one.

meaning: The report was not created because a verified statement does not resolve to intact case evidence.
fix: Open the preview, read the listed problems (missing, redacted or altered evidence) and fix or remove those statements.

meaning: A claim needs an object entity or a value.
fix: Fill in the value or choose an entity.

meaning: This case does not allow sending content to a cloud model.
fix: Use a local model, or change the case's AI policy on the AI tab (your decision, per case).

meaning: A confirmation is needed.
fix: Review the preview and confirm.

meaning: This is an explicit action and needs confirm=true (the UI sends it when you press the confirm button).
fix: Press the confirm button in the UI; nothing happens until you do.

meaning: Consent recorded for a human source has expired.
fix: Renew consent on the Humint tab before adding more material.

meaning: You must tick that you own or are authorised to import the material.
fix: Tick the ownership/authorisation box on the Imports or Evidence tab before choosing a file.

meaning: Consent for this source was withdrawn.
fix: No further material may be added or used for this source.

meaning: Confirming an account needs the subject's attestation or independent evidence; a matching handle is not enough.
fix: Tick 'the subject attests' (self-audit) or attach evidence that does not come from the handle check itself.

meaning: The descriptor is longer than 200 characters.
fix: Shorten it to a category, provider and date.

meaning: That hardware device is already recording.
fix: Stop the running capture on the Hardware tab first.

meaning: The update server name could not be resolved.
fix: Check the address and your network.

meaning: An item with that name already exists.
fix: Choose another name.

meaning: That alias already exists in this case.
fix: Use a different alias.

meaning: The authorization is longer than allowed for this mode.
fix: Use a shorter period and renew when it ends.

meaning: The upload was empty.
fix: Choose a file with content.

meaning: Accepting needs an evidence item from this case.
fix: Pick an evidence item first.

meaning: The authorization end date has already passed.
fix: Choose a date in the future.

meaning: The downloaded update does not match the signed SHA-256 and was deleted.
fix: Re-publish the file and manifest together; never run a file that failed verification.

meaning: Recurring monitoring of an individual needs a documented case purpose and an acknowledgement.
fix: Write the case purpose and tick the acknowledgement when creating the schedule.

meaning: The report audience must be 'subject' or 'analyst'.
fix: Pick one of the two.

meaning: A cited evidence item does not belong to this case.
fix: Cite evidence from the same case.

meaning: The input is not an allowed identifier kind or value.
fix: Use a name, alias, username, email, domain, URL or organization. Government or financial identifiers and secrets are never accepted.

meaning: The file could not be decoded as an image, or it is truncated or too large when decoded.
fix: Re-save the image from an image editor; very large dimensions are refused.

meaning: The plugin package or its manifest is not valid.
fix: Check the manifest against the plugin SDK documentation and re-import.

meaning: The password check accepts exactly five hexadecimal characters.
fix: Use the in-app password check; it hashes in your browser and sends only the first five characters.

meaning: That AI profile type is not valid.
fix: Ollama and llama.cpp profiles are always local (loopback addresses); cloud profiles need an https URL.

meaning: The schedule definition is not valid.
fix: Choose a supported interval and a valid workflow.

meaning: A setting name or value is not allowed.
fix: Use a value the Settings page offers.

meaning: The licence basis for this dataset does not permit importing it.
fix: Provide the licence basis and licensor the dataset allows, or do not import it.

meaning: The imported file could not be parsed.
fix: Check the file type and that the file is not damaged; the Imports tab lists supported kinds.

meaning: That merge would be circular or self-referential.
fix: Pick two different entities that are not already merged into each other.

meaning: A network request failed (no route, refused, timed out).
fix: Check the network or the server address; the message names the exception type.

meaning: A claim with no evidence cannot be verified.
fix: Attach an evidence item to the claim first.

meaning: No RDAP server is known for that TLD.
fix: Try a different registry source (crt.sh or DNS) for that domain.

meaning: No update server address is set.
fix: Settings -> Updates: enter the manifest address.

meaning: The item does not exist (or you cannot access it).
fix: Reload the page; the item may have been deleted.

meaning: That tool is not on the installable list for this operating system.
fix: Open Setup to see what can be installed here, or install the tool yourself and re-check in Tool Manager.

meaning: The tool is not installed.
fix: Setup: tick the tool and press Install selected, or install it yourself; then re-check in Tool Manager.

meaning: The authorization is not valid yet.
fix: Wait until its start time or record a new one.

meaning: Nothing was selected.
fix: Select at least one item and try again.

meaning: Offline mode is on, so network sources and downloads are denied.
fix: Settings -> turn Offline mode off. Local AI and stored cases keep working in offline mode.

meaning: No live authorization covers this source class or identifier.
fix: Add the class or identifier to a new authorization, or choose a source that is covered.

meaning: A tool's output could not be parsed.
fix: The raw output was kept as evidence; check the tool version in Tool Manager.

meaning: The plugin action was refused (not reviewed, hash changed, or it asked for something not allowed).
fix: Review the manifest in Settings -> Plugins; a changed file disables the plugin until you accept the new hash.

meaning: A plugin file changed after it was approved.
fix: It is disabled again; review the manifest and accept the new hash if you trust it.

meaning: Policy would currently block part of this workflow.
fix: Preview the workflow, read which step is blocked and why, then change the target or settings.

meaning: Policy refused the plan or request (for example offline mode, a closed case, a private/forbidden destination, or an unconfirmed active source). Nothing was started.
fix: Read the denial reason shown with it; it names the rule. Fix the cause (turn offline mode off, confirm the sources that need confirmation) and preview again.

meaning: This mode needs verifiable proof of consent.
fix: Attach the signed document or confirmation as case evidence and choose a verifiable method.

meaning: People/public-identity cases need a documented purpose.
fix: Write the purpose of the investigation when creating the case.

meaning: Client authorizations must list the permitted purposes.
fix: Add at least one purpose.

meaning: The source asked the app to slow down.
fix: Wait the stated time; the app never tries to evade rate limits. Try another source meanwhile.

meaning: Report generation raised an error.
fix: Check the troubleshooting log for the exception, try another format (HTML/Markdown) and report the exception name.

meaning: The source needs configuration before it can run.
fix: Read the warning on the run; for Amass this is data sources in its config file.

meaning: The source needs an API key that is not stored.
fix: Setup -> API keys: paste the key and Save. Without one the source makes no request.

meaning: A remediation task can only be resolved with evidence of the fix or retest.
fix: Attach case evidence (for example a screenshot or note) and resolve again.

meaning: DNS lookup failed.
fix: Check connectivity; the name may not exist.

meaning: A backup could not be restored (wrong passphrase, damaged file, or the target folder is not empty).
fix: Restore always writes into a new empty folder; check the passphrase and the file. The existing data folder is never modified.

meaning: You must confirm you own the image, it is public, or you have documented authorization to analyse it.
fix: Tick the confirmation on the import form.

meaning: That report or view needs the editor or owner role.
fix: Ask a case owner to raise your role on this case.

meaning: Client authorizations must name the identities they cover.
fix: Tick the identities this consent applies to.

meaning: The text looks like it contains a secret, a credential or a government/financial identifier.
fix: Describe the category instead (for example 'breach 2023, passwords exposed'). Exposure records never hold secrets.

meaning: The operating system credential store could not be used for a key.
fix: Unlock or install a credential store (on Linux a Secret Service such as gnome-keyring); without one the app seals keys in its encrypted database.

meaning: This case forbids sending RESTRICTED material to a cloud model.
fix: Use a local model or change the case policy.

meaning: The subject is paused, closed or purged.
fix: Set the subject back to active before collecting.

meaning: The source did not answer in time.
fix: Retry later or use an alternative source for the same question.

meaning: The upload exceeds the size limit.
fix: Use a smaller file, or trim the capture.

meaning: Entities of different types cannot be merged.
fix: Merge only entities of the same type.

meaning: A plugin tried to reach a network address it did not declare.
fix: The plugin is blocked by design; review its manifest.

meaning: The model is not in the setup catalog.
fix: Pick a model listed in Setup, or add your own profile in Settings -> AI.

meaning: A selected source or input is not part of this target's plan.
fix: Preview the plan again and select from the list shown.

meaning: An email address in the text is not masked.
fix: Mask it, for example j***@example.com.

meaning: The file is not a plain raster image (SVG, HTML, PDF, archives and executables are refused).
fix: Export the picture as JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP or TIFF and import that.

meaning: That image format is not accepted.
fix: Convert it to JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP or TIFF.

meaning: The file type could not be detected.
fix: Choose the type explicitly on the Imports tab; the message lists supported kinds.

meaning: This tool does not run on this operating system.
fix: Use an alternative (Tool Manager lists them) or run on a supported OS.

meaning: The request did not match the expected shape (a missing field, wrong type or value out of range).
fix: Check the highlighted field in the form; the details list which field failed.

meaning: Sensitive checks need more than a self-attestation.
fix: Use email confirmation, provider verification, a signed document or in-person verification.

meaning: Active verification is switched off in this installation, so nothing active can run.
fix: An administrator turns it on in the case's Verification tab > Status. It is off by default.

meaning: No asset authorization covers this action.
fix: Record an asset authorization (case owner) that names the exact hosts, ports and checks, then build the plan again.

meaning: The asset authorization has passed its end date.
fix: Record a new authorization. Old ones are never extended silently.

meaning: The asset authorization was revoked; approvals and running checks stopped at once.
fix: Record a new authorization if the work should continue.

meaning: The authorization's start time has not arrived yet.
fix: Wait until it starts or record one with the right start.

meaning: The host is not named in the authorization (or its address is not allowed).
fix: Check the host spelling and the authorization's scope. A different host needs its own authorization.

meaning: The port is not one the authorization permits.
fix: Use a listed port or record an authorization that lists it.

meaning: The authorization does not permit this kind of check.
fix: Record an authorization that includes the check class, or choose a permitted check.

meaning: The name resolved to an address that is never allowed (private, loopback, link-local or cloud-metadata space).
fix: Use a public host you are authorized to test. Private lab hosts need an explicit lab-network statement.

meaning: The authorization changed after the plan was approved, so the approval no longer applies.
fix: Create a new plan from the current authorization and approve it again.

meaning: A plan approval is single use and has been used.
fix: Review the plan and approve it again to run it once more.

meaning: The approval ran out of time before the run started.
fix: Approve the plan again (approvals last at most four hours).

meaning: The approval was given for a different plan or version.
fix: Approve the plan you want to run; editing a plan creates a new version that needs its own approval.

meaning: A signature template is not approved by id and content hash.
fix: Review it under Verification > Templates and approve that exact text, or remove it from the plan.

meaning: The template makes requests the review does not allow (not read-only GET/HEAD, has payloads, bodies, headers, flows or other protocols).
fix: Use a plain fingerprint template, or do not use that template.

meaning: An explicit approval is needed for this change.
fix: Preview it, then tick the approval box and apply.

meaning: The product name is not acceptable (for example it uses 'Intel' as a brand or contains markup).
fix: Use a name of 3 to 60 characters without markup; 'Intelligence' is fine, 'Intel' alone is not.

meaning: There are no confirmed observations at that severity to export.
fix: Review the observations and confirm the ones that are real, then export again.

meaning: A DARKINT provider's terms have not been accepted.
fix: An administrator reads the provider's terms and enables it with the confirmation.

meaning: The authorization does not permit this exposure provider.
fix: Record an authorization that lists the provider, or leave the list empty to allow any enabled provider.

meaning: This provider cannot be scheduled (password checks and manual sources are owner-initiated only).
fix: Run it by hand from the Exposure tab.

meaning: Domain-wide breach lookups are run by hand after domain verification, not scheduled.
fix: Run the lookup from the DARKINT tab after verifying the domain with the provider.

meaning: The provider (or its documented rate limit) said to slow down.
fix: Wait and try again; the free Ransomware.live interface allows about one request per minute.

meaning: There are no verification runs to put in a report yet.
fix: Approve and run a plan first, then create the report.

meaning: That is not a valid email address.
fix: Check the spelling; use the form name@domain.

meaning: Only a confirmed address can be added as an input.
fix: Confirm it first with the owner's attestation or independent corroboration.

meaning: Addresses with different decisions cannot be merged.
fix: Resolve the decisions first (reopen the rejected one, or confirm both).

meaning: A selected research step is not available in the plan (blocked, already done, beyond the depth limit, or it needs its own approval).
fix: Open the plan, read each step's status, and tick only ready steps.

meaning: An expansion limit is outside what is allowed.
fix: Use whole numbers: depth 1 to 4, total runs 1 to 100, runs per pass 1 to 20.

meaning: That expansion setting does not exist.
fix: Use max_depth, max_runs, max_per_pass or auto_passive.

meaning: That address is already one of the subject's own inputs.
fix: Nothing to do: it is researched as an input.

meaning: The shared-provider list entry is not a plain domain name.
fix: Enter a domain such as mail.example.net, without a path or an @.

meaning: The state filter or requested state is not one of Unassessed, Candidate, Corroborated, Conflicting, Rejected or Not available.
fix: Pick one of the listed states.

meaning: The only support is the subject's own statement, which is recorded as self-attestation and is never independent corroboration.
fix: Add evidence from an independent source and tick 'independent of the subject', or leave the item as a candidate.

meaning: Revealing or recording a restricted value is limited to the case owner.
fix: Ask the case owner, or work with the masked value.

meaning: A restricted field (date of birth, phone, address, identity reference) needs a stated reason it is required.
fix: Type why the value is needed; the reason is recorded.

meaning: There is no current authorization for this subject, so restricted values cannot be recorded or revealed.
fix: Record or renew the authorization in the Authorization tab.

meaning: This value is stored only as a masked form and a keyed token, so it cannot be revealed.
fix: Use Compare to check a number against the stored token.

meaning: Compare works only on identity-document or SSN reference items.
fix: Choose a reference item.

meaning: Reveal applies only to restricted items.
fix: This value is not masked; read it directly.

meaning: A reveal needs a reason of at least ten characters, which is audited.
fix: Describe why you need to see the value.

meaning: An input's value cannot be edited in place because research is tied to it.
fix: Retire it and add the corrected value.

meaning: This type of item cannot be used as a research input.
fix: Only emails, usernames, domains, URLs, names, aliases and organizations can be inputs.

meaning: The origin is not one of the supported ones.
fix: Choose subject provided, analyst supplied, published source or verified provider.

meaning: The item type is not in the Master Profile catalog.
fix: Pick a listed type, or use a custom attribute.

meaning: Confidence must be unknown, low, medium or high.
fix: Pick one of the four.

meaning: The value is not valid for this type of item.
fix: Check the format, for example a date as YYYY-MM-DD or a phone number with digits.

meaning: That evidence belongs to a different case.
fix: Use evidence stored in this case.

meaning: A custom attribute needs a name.
fix: Type the attribute name.

meaning: The import has more rows than one batch allows.
fix: Split the file into smaller parts.

meaning: The file could not be read as CSV or JSON, or is not a list of objects with type and value.
fix: Check the format and the header row.

meaning: The selected evidence is not about that site, so it cannot support that account.
fix: Choose evidence from the same site, or leave Independent evidence on None and record a self-attestation.

meaning: This was rejected. A rejected value never drives research.
fix: Reopen it (Needs review) first if you changed your mind.

meaning: An input or a reviewed claim keeps its type, because its research history is attached to it.
fix: Add it again with the right type and retire the old one.

meaning: Restricted types cannot be created by changing the type of another item.
fix: Add a restricted value directly, as the case owner, with a stated need.

meaning: The item already has that type.
fix: Pick a different type.

meaning: This item was never reclassified.
fix: Nothing to undo.

meaning: None of the values could be used as inputs.
fix: Check each value's type, for example an email must contain an @.

meaning: Only a running investigation can be paused.
fix: Use Resume or Stop instead.

meaning: This investigation is running or already finished.
fix: Wait for it to finish, or start a new one.

meaning: This investigation is already finished.
fix: Nothing to stop.

meaning: The decision is not one of Mine, Not mine, Unsure or Need evidence.
fix: Pick one of the four.

meaning: An item in the selection is not recognised.
fix: Refresh the page and select again.

meaning: Too many items in one batch.
fix: Review at most 200 at a time.
